title: Ultimate Alert
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the blood pulse pierced through the void, Chen Ji felt his heart wrench with a sudden jolt—that frequency, so familiar it was etched into his bones, was identical to his sister Chen Nian, whom he had been separated from for years, yet fundamentally different. At this moment, he finally understood the true meaning of Mo Xiansheng's words: 'The other half of fate never fails to appear.'

text.content: In the void, a dull bell toll resounded through heaven and earth. The runes on the 796th page of the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with blinding golden light, which pierced through Chen Ji's brow center and exploded like thunder in his mental sea. 'Ultimate Alert—the Heavenly Secret Eye has entered its final observation phase.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity. 'Chen Ji, this is the strongest observation you have faced since beginning your cultivation. It no longer probes, no longer hides—it wants to thoroughly see through everything about you.'

Chen Ji stood at the cliff edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, howling winds whipping his robes violently. His expression was terrifyingly calm, yet deep within those seemingly murky eyes burned an unprecedented sharp light. The tremor of the Ultimate Alert spread through every meridian in his body, each blood vessel feeling like it was being seared by a branding iron. The number of his Heavenly Fate value jumped frantically in his mental sea—5, 10, 15, 20—as if an invisible hand was rapidly draining his most precious life essence.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng, how much time do I have?

At its current observation speed, half an hour at most. But the problem is—while it's observing you, it's also observing another person. That person's entanglement of fate with yours exceeds my calculations.

text.content: Before the words finished, the sky suddenly darkened. Not the darkness of clouds obscuring the sun, but a pure, suffocating void. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply—at the center of that void, an eye was slowly opening. That eye was too massive, impossibly large, violating all his understanding of heaven and earth's laws. Within its pupil swirled galaxy-like light, each rotation causing the collapse and rebirth of countless dimensions.

That was the Heavenly Secret Eye—no, that was an eye surpassing the Heavenly Way! Chen Ji felt his soul trembling violently—not from fear, but from an instinctive surrender deep within his life force. Countless laws crumbled into nothingness under that eye's observation. All things in heaven and earth seemed utterly insignificant and卑微 before it. However, just as Chen Ji was about to kneel, a cold smile curled at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: You want me to kneel? Dream on. I, Chen Ji, kneel to heaven, to earth, to my parents—but never to a lurking, prying observer. You want to see through me? Go ahead—let's see what you can actually see from me!

text.content: Just as Chen Ji withstood the Heavenly Secret Eye's observation, a cold and tyrannical aura came hurtling through the extreme distance, piercing through layers of void to sear itself into Chen Ji's soul's depths. Then, a woman's voice, filled with enchantment and authority, exploded in his mind: 'Chen Ji, this one has waited for you a long time. The call of fate has been issued—are you going to accept it, or continue being that cowardly deserter?'

dialogue.content: (The voice of the Demonic Path army commander) We are both chess pieces toyed with by fate. Rather than being devoured by that eye, why not join hands with me? At least here, you can find true equality and respect.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a violent dizziness—that was the resonance between twin fates! The summoning force and the Heavenly Secret Eye's observation formed a bizarre tug-of-war within his body, tearing at his soul's boundaries. Silently, he sensed the existence of another life—connected to him by identical blood pulses, yet separated by mysterious forces thousands of miles away.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Secret Eye's ultimate observation and the Demonic Path commander's fate summons descend simultaneously. Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Face the Heavenly Secret Eye directly
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record Fragment to strike at that eye surpassing the Heavenly Way, attacking in defense to forcibly interrupt its observation. This is a massive gamble with enormous consumption, but if successful, it will completely break its voyeuristic封锁 on you.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate value (-30 points), endure Heavenly backlash
choices.visible_reward: Interrupt the observation, gain breathing room, may trigger new ability unlock of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk: if failed, Heavenly Fate value drops to zero, soul takes damage

text.content: A decisive light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He bit down hard on his tongue, using his essence blood to activate the forbidden runes on the Tianji Record Fragment. Golden light erupted from within his body, colliding violently with the Heavenly Secret Eye's observation in mid-air!

A roar as if from the primordial chaos rang out. Chen Ji felt his soul being torn into thousands of fragments. But within that tearing, he caught a glimpse of surprise deep within that eye—it hadn't expected a mere ant to dare resist!

choices.description: Temporarily abandon resistance to the Heavenly Secret Eye, focus your attention on the Demonic Path commander's fate summons. Through the twin fate connection, secretly lay plans, seeking breakthrough opportunities in the gaps. This is a path of wisdom using retreat as advance.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the pain from Heavenly observation (lose 5 Heavenly Fate points per round), temporarily not gain initiative
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path commander's fate link, glimpse the secret of twin fates
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk: sustained pressure, but gain key intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, actively收敛ing his resisting aura, allowing the Heavenly Secret Eye's observation to fall upon himself. That feeling of being thoroughly seen was like thorns on his back, but his mind became unprecedentedly clear at this moment—because he concentrated all his attention on that purple fate summons.

Through that fate link, Chen Ji glimpsed an astonishing scene: the Demonic Path army commander's true face was actually a woman with a five-point resemblance to Ye Qing. And behind her stood a figure he knew all too well—

choices.text: Break the Situation by Borrowing Momentum
choices.description: Use the opposition between the Heavenly Secret Eye and the Demonic Path commander, deliberately create conflict between them. Let them constrain and exhaust each other, while Chen Ji escapes to find the true breakthrough point. This is a conspiracy of three-way chess.
choices.visible_cost: Consume the Tianji Record's foresight ability (-20 Heavenly Fate points), expose some hidden cards
choices.visible_reward: Provoke conflict between the Heavenly Secret Eye and the Demonic Path commander, gain opportunity to escape
choices.risk_hint: Medium risk: if exposed, will offend both sides simultaneously

text.content: Chen Ji's smile deepened. He suddenly spoke, his voice not loud, yet clearly transmitted into the perceptions of two transcendent beings: 'Both of you are mighty beings beyond the mortal realm—why trouble yourselves over a tiny ant like me? Why not—let's make a deal?'

The Heavenly Secret Eye's pupil slightly constricted, while that purple fate summons fluctuated violently. Chen Ji knew he had successfully attracted both parties' attention—the next step would be the crucial provocation and scheming.

However, just then, an even more shocking scene penetrated Chen Ji's perception—the call of fate, a connection more fundamental than any power. His Heavenly Fate value jumped frantically at this moment, not from consumption, but from resonance! At the other end of the void, another life connected to him by blood was being forcibly awakened!

Chen Ji felt his heart tighten painfully. That blood pulse frequency—he knew it too well—it was Chen Nian! His sister! The sister taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'! However, beside Chen Nian's pulse existed another even more powerful, even more strange blood resonance. That frequency matched his own perfectly, yet had subtle differences.

dialogue.content: Impossible... twin fates... the other party... is not me?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying a sigh: 'Chen Ji, do you understand now? You were never alone. The Tianji Record chose you because you are one party of the twin fates. And the other party—' He paused, 'She has always been under the Holy Sect's control. The connection between you two—that is the Tianji Record's true core secret.'

At this very moment, the Heavenly Secret Eye's observation and the Demonic Path commander's summons both reached their peak. Three transcendent forces collided violently within Chen Ji. His soul constantly struggled between tearing and restructuring. Yet precisely at this life-or-death boundary, an unprecedented light ignited in Chen Ji's eyes—he finally saw his chessboard clearly, saw the true opponent hidden within fate's depths.

Chen Ji opened his eyes suddenly. Those eyes, once murky and timid, were now sharp as blades. He looked at the Heavenly Secret Eye, his voice not loud yet carrying undeniable firmness: 'You want to see through my fate? Fine, today I'll let you see clearly—just see if this so-called Heavenly Secret Eye has the qualification to decide my life or death!'

However, just as Chen Ji prepared to unleash all his hidden cards, a blood pulse frequency achingly familiar to his bones suddenly pierced through the void. That pulse was identical to Chen Nian's, yet fundamentally different—that was not Chen Nian, that was... another existence connected to Chen Ji by the same blood! Chen Ji's heart seemed to skip half a beat. A wild thought formed in his mind: the other half of fate... was never Chen Nian?

In that lightning-flash moment, Chen Ji sensed the precise location of that existence—it was not at the Holy Sect, but deep within the Demonic Path army! An existence sealed and protected by the Demonic Path commander at the highest level, an existence even the Heavenly Secret Eye could not fully observe. His twin fate partner had been within the Demonic Path army all along!

Deep in the void, that eye surpassing the Heavenly Way slowly rotated. Countless laws disintegrated and reorganized around it. While it observed Chen Ji, it also looked in another direction—the depths of the Demonic Path army. The Heavenly Secret Eye issued a silent mockery, seemingly mocking Chen Ji's ignorance, yet also mocking fate's absurdity. And at this moment, Chen Ji finally understood the true meaning of Mo Xiansheng's 'Ultimate Alert'—this was not an alert aimed at one person, but an ultimate alert for the entire fate chess game!
